close_reason: Integration test added: self_issued_rsa_anchor_absent_params_not_no_trusted_path; verifies guard doesn't return NoTrustedPath for same-key anchor with different param encoding
description: The unit test (tests_rsa::spki_key_matches_ignores_null_vs_absent_params) validates spki_key_matches in isolation. The guard call site in validate_path (lines 410-417) is not exercised end-to-end for the acceptance case. A regression that reverts the guard from !spki_key_matches(...) back to != would not be caught by any test — all existing tests would still pass. To cover: add a test in tests_validate_path that builds a TrustAnchor with parameters:None from the RSA cert (same OID + key bytes, absent params), calls validate_path with the cert as chain[0], and asserts Ok(...). The forged_anchor_name_match_spki_mismatch_rejected test covers the rejection direction; the acceptance direction (different encoding, same key) is uncovered.
title: No validate_path integration test for NULL-vs-absent acceptance path
